description.en: Reads back a CRC32 checksum value associated with the last member added via CMND_BTL_ADD_MEMBER.
The stored CRC32 value; null if the call was invalid or no member has been added yet.

example.code:
// Read back the CRC of the last member added to the match roster
local crc = CMND_BTL_GET_ADD_MEMBER_CRC();
